title: Tribunus Metrics Vocabulary
description: Standard metrics vocabulary for all Tribunus subsystems. Every metric emitted follows this contract.

counter.description: A monotonically increasing count. Never decreases. Used for: request count, error count, bytes processed.

gauge.description: A value that can go up and down. Used for: active sessions, queue depth, memory usage, open file handles.

histogram.description: A distribution of values across configurable buckets. Used for: request latency, message size, token count.

summary.description: A summary with quantiles. Used when bucket boundaries are not known in advance.

service.description: Subsystem emitting the metric (coordination, session, tool, provider, http, cockpit)

operation.description: The operation being measured (e.g., completeAndAck, stream.read, prompt.execute)

result.description: Outcome of the operation (completed, failed, timeout, cancelled)

rules: Suffix: unit (seconds, bytes, total, count, ratio)

emission_contract.frequency: Configurable per metric type (default: counter on change, gauge every 15s, histogram/summary on observation)
